title: codex exec in CI finishes but changes no files
symptoms: The final message describes edits, but git diff is empty
Commands that write files fail with permission errors inside codex exec
cause: codex exec runs in a read-only sandbox by default, so automation that expects edits gets none.
fix: Pass --sandbox workspace-write for runs that edit, or danger-full-access only on an isolated runner.
apply: codex exec --sandbox workspace-write "fix the failing tests"
affected: Codex CLI codex exec, as of 2026-10
